_about: EADS-CASA, CN-235-300 Technical Review (2002), page 4 'Three View Drawing', as published by the BLM / NIFC (CN235Report.pdf): the side view is an embedded 596 x 226 px picture (shaded, outlines from black to grey), extracted as it is (side_raw.png) and rendered with layers.py --mode lines --contrast 25 at scale 4 (3 raster px per picture px; pymupdf opens a PNG at 96 dpi). Pixels of that raster, line centres. The picture is cropped at the nose tip and the tail cone. The black radome is drawn filled: the nose tip and the first 0.15 m of the crown and belly are placed (free). The nacelle, seen from the side, hides the crown from the spinner to behind the wing (bridged); the main gear's sponson hides the belly between its ends (bridged). The fin's leading edge is drawn as a thick black de-icing boot: its outer edge is placed (free points along it, 2 px inside the ink's edge). The nacelle runs from the propeller to its tail behind the wing, its top along the wing's lower surface.
